title: Schmidt-Gauge Non-Local Magic: Representation, Optimality, and Mathematical Properties
summary: While the full non-stabilizerness (magic) of a quantum state contains local, basis-dependent contributions, a non-local formulation based on a minimization over local unitaries isolates the component associated with genuinely non-local correlations. Within such a framework, the Schmidt-gauge formulation of non-local magic provides a direct connection between genuinely non-local non-stabilizer correlations and the entanglement spectrum of quantum many-body states.
